from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row.count(line) >= 0.7*w]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if sum(row[c] == line for row in grid) >= 0.7*h]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
        rowout = []
        for j in range(len(cs)-1):
            corners = [grid[rs[i]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i]][cs[j+1]], grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j+1]]]
            v = corners[0] if len(set(corners)) == 1 and corners[0] != line else bg
            rowout.append(v)
        out.append(rowout)
    if not out or not out[0]: return out
    active_r = [i for i,row in enumerate(out) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    active_c = [j for j in range(len(out[0])) if any(out[i][j] != bg for i in range(len(out)))]
    if active_r and active_c:
        out = [row[active_c[0]:active_c[-1]+1] for row in out[active_r[0]:active_r[-1]+1]]
    return out
'''
